GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Recovered & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide until improved 1 length @ 700m & pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 450m. Chasing Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Raced tight @ 200m & faded in last 100m. Vetted clear. Rider - didn't handle tight turning track. # didn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Raced keenly in the early stages. Tightened near the 200m. When questioned, apprentice stated that his mount was overly disappointing and did not handle the tight turning surface. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
